target_buyer.why_top_candidate: Family-owned since 1947 in Trumbull Township, Ashtabula County. Offers complete meat processing with custom cut options, fresh meat counter, deli, and produce section. Serves local farm community processing beef, pork, and chicken. Old Fashioned Hickory Smoked meats specialty. Digital cut sheet tool would streamline customer ordering and reduce manual paperwork.

offerings: Fresh meat counter (7 days a week)
Hickory smoked meats (jerky, smokies, bacon, hams)
products: Choice Steaks, Ribs, Pork Chops, Chicken
actual_brand_research.visual_style: Traditional, family-owned, hickory-smoked heritage, local farm partnerships
